title: alchemilla vulgaris var. trunciloba
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris var. trunciloba, commonly known as a variety of the common lady's mantle, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to soothe and calm the digestive system, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla vulgaris var. trunciloba are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal effects are flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which have been shown to have potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
